notes:
Summary: Enterprise fintech platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated for low-latency customer chat + high-throughput reranking. Primary ask:
- Throughput guarantees (tokens/sec per model) and clear latency SLOs (P95 <= 120ms, P99 <= 350ms) under target load.
- Guidance for reserved GPU planning: expected baseline capacity for 3M monthly active users, burst profile 3x baseline during market opens.
- Autoscaling behavior: need deterministic scale-up/scale-down rules, warm pool sizing suggestions, pre-warm time estimates per GPU family.
- Queueing/backpressure: how requests are queued vs rejected, SLA for queued requests, fair-share across routes.

Recent call notes (02/09 perf sync): "If scale-up takes >30s we risk losing sessions" — engineering stressed pre-warmed instances required for chat route.
CS quote: "costs must not double during market open bursts; want predictable billing model for bursts."
Security: mandatory SSO/SAML, keys in customer KMS, data residency for NA only, 7-year audit logs retained.
POC plan: 1) baseline perf run (24h), 2) 72h perf with warm-pool configs A/B, 3) cost modeling and SLA draft, 4) legal DPA sign.
Requested artifacts: dedicated sizing calculator (spreadsheet), warm-pool best-practices doc, queued-request SLA template.

Action items: SE to run perf script (Rohit) w/ warm-pool B by 2026-02-18; AE to coordinate procurement packet; CSM to prepare onboarding checklist.
